completion_evidence: Source-derived atoms and provider or framework variants are cited; required checks and authorization evidence are recorded.
hard_gates: Fail closed on missing authority, credentials, source evidence, required data governance, or verification.
inputs: Isolated worktree, change branch, approved base reference, clean-state evidence, and local mutation authority.
name: Local Branch Integration
non_responsibility: Does not absorb unrelated lifecycle responsibilities or expand provider, workspace, or remote-write authority implicitly.
outputs: Integrated local branch or conflict report, before and after refs, changed-file evidence, and recovery command.
responsibility: Integrate an approved base branch into an isolated local change branch, surface conflicts, and preserve a recoverable pre-integration reference without remote writes.
stop_conditions: Stop before destructive, external-write, merge, deploy, or production action without current explicit authorization.
